subject: Otto
text: Talking to Otto again in Windia starts up the Rainbow Road, allowing access to Pazuzu's Tower.

evidence.quote:
When you arrive back in Windia, talk to Otto again. He'll start up the
Rainbow Road, allowing you to access Pazuzu's Tower!

subject: North Exit
text: Heading north through town and taking the North Exit leads to Pazuzu's Tower.

evidence.quote:
Leave the house,
and head north through town. Take the North Exit, to reach Pazuzu's 
Tower.

subject: Seeds
text: An old lady outside the Inn sells Seeds.

evidence.quote:
Remember to stop at the Inn, and rest, as well as talking to the
old lady outside, to buy some Seeds - Buy as many as you can, so you
don't need to stock up later.

subject: Norma
text: Talking to the little girl Norma on the right platform rescues her so she returns home.

evidence.quote:
When you first enter, head up to the platform on the right, and talk to
the little girl. She turns out to be Norma, and when you tak to her, she
returns home.

subject: Pazuzu
text: Talking to the large bird creature Pazuzu in the center of the first room causes him to run away.

evidence.quote:
After you rescue her, fight your way up, thorugh the center of
the room, and talk to the large bird creature, who is actually Pazuza.
He'll then run away.

subject: Stairs
text: Taking the door on the right where Norma was leads past a Beholder to the stairs up to the second floor.

evidence.quote:
Go back to where you found Norma, and take the door
on the right. Defeat the Beholder, and go up the stairs.

When you enter the second floor

subject: Stairs
text: Climbing the stairs on the second floor and passing through the top door leads to the third floor.

evidence.quote:
begin climbing
the stairs in front of you. Defeat another on a platform between stairs,
and keep going. At the top of the stairs, is another door. You're now
at the third floor - Fast huh?

subject: Chests
text: Chests inside the upper room on the third floor contain Explosives.

evidence.quote:
Go through the door on the
right, and fight some more enemies, moving upward, into another room.
Defeat one/some of the enemies, and take the Explosives from the chests.

subject: Stairway
text: Going around the wall on the third floor leads to the fourth floor stairway.

evidence.quote:
head bac to the left, and go 
around the wall, to the door (You'll have to defeat a Chimera, Beholder,
and a Manticor to get there.)

You'll enter the fourth floor - which is a stairway like the second 
floor.

subject: Door
text: Passing through the door at the top of the fourth floor stairway reaches the fifth floor.

evidence.quote:
Head to the top, killing some Beholders on the way. From here,
go through the door to reach the fifth floor.

subject: Stairs
text: Walking around the platform on the fifth floor and going through the door leads up stairs to the sixth floor.

evidence.quote:
walk around the platform you enter on. Go through the door, and head 
up another flight of stairs. Guess what? The sixth floor is yet another
set of stairs!

subject: Stairs
text: Climbing up the sixth floor stairs reaches the seventh floor.

evidence.quote:
Climb up them, defeating the Manticores, until you reach
the seventh floor.

subject: Chest
text: A chest on the sixth floor room contains Cure Potions.

evidence.quote:
go down
some more stairs, to the 6th floor again....In the next room, grab some Cure Potions
from the chest

subject: Fancy chest
text: A fancy chest on the left side of the room contains the final Wizard spell, Flare.

evidence.quote:
reach a fancy
chest, which is on the left side of the room.
Inside, is the final 
Wizard spell, Flare!

subject: Switch
text: Bombing open the wall on the right and advancing past Pazuzu allows you to hit the switch with your axe.

evidence.quote:
bomb open the wall on the right.
Defeat the Naga on the other side, and then defeat the Sorcerer. Head
forward, and talk to Pazuzu, who will flee again, then turn around, 
and hit the switch with your axe.

subject: Chests
text: Chests down the steps to the right contain Explosives and Heal Potions.

evidence.quote:
Farhter to the right, you can head down
some steps, and reach chests that contain Explosives and Heal Potions.

subject: Fancy chest
text: Opening the fancy chest through the door yields the Excalibur sword.

evidence.quote:
On the right,
after defeating some more monsters, is a door. Fight the Sorcerer, and
head through it. Defeat a Chimera or two, and another Sorcerer, to get
to anotherfancy chest.Open it, to get the incredibly strong Excalibur
sword!

subject: Chests
text: Chests near where Pazuzu appears past the blown-open door contain Cure and Heal Potions.

evidence.quote:
Blow it open, and head 
forward, killing the Gargoyles, until you meet Pazuzu again. Grab the
Cure and Heal Potions, and talk to him - He'll run away yet again.

subject: Chests
text: The door on the right leads to more Cure and Heal Potions.

evidence.quote:
There's
another door on the right - Go there for soem more Cure and Heal Potions,
then heads up the path on the left of it, killing the monsters, and hit
the switch.

subject: Pazuzu
text: Pazuzu can be confronted for battle on floor 5.

evidence.quote:
make your way back to floor 5 - you shouldn't have to fight anyone, you
did this before already. Here, you can talk to Pazuzu again. This time,
he won't run though! Make sure to heal, and save, then get ready to go.

subject: Pazuzu
text: Pazuzu has 25,000 HP, awards 618 EXP and 0 GP, and is weak to Wind and the Aero spell.

evidence.quote:
Pazuzu  - 25,000HP...EXP: 618     | Battle Strategy: Pazuzu can do some big damage, with |
| GP: 0        | his attacks, but at least he fights alone, and has a |
O--------------O weakness - Wind. Use Aero each turn

subject: Chest
text: Defeating Pazuzu frees the Sky Crystal at the top of the tower shaft, where a chest contains the Sky Coin.

evidence.quote:
When you defeat Pazuzu, you'll automatically begin moving through the 
tower shaft. At the top, you free the Sky Crystal! Open the chest, to
get the Sky Coin

subject: Reuben
text: Reuben greets you at Otto's house and joins the party as Kaeli leaves.

evidence.quote:
Go into Otto's house, and talk to Otto, when you arrive. Who should
come to greet you, but Reuben! Kaeli leaves, allowing Reuben to take
her place as your parner

subject: Arion
text: Talking to the man lying down in bed at Reuben's house in Fireburg gives you the Thunder Rock.

evidence.quote:
When you arrive in Fireburg, go to Reuben's house - It's the one to the
left of the Hotel. Talk to the man who's lying down in the bed, and 
he'll give you the thunder Rock that you need.

subject: Otto
text: Talking to Otto makes him power up his machine in the basement, creating a second rainbow path to Spencer's Place.

evidence.quote:
Again, go to Otto's house, and talk to Otto. He'll go to the basement,
and power up his machine, and come back shortly. He'll say you can now
access Spencer's place! Leave the town, and sure enough, there's a 
second rainbow path, just north of Pazuzu's Tower, heading to Spencer's
Place.

subject: Reuben
text: Reuben throws a Mega Grenade upon entering Spencer's Place, flooding the world map and freeing Mac's Ship.

evidence.quote:
As soon as you enter, Reuben changes the whole layout with a Mega 
Grenade, causing the world map to flood, freeing Mac's Ship!

subject: Blocked door
text: Tossing a Mega Grenade clears the blocked door on the platform across the water.

evidence.quote:
First, walk forward, and get into the water. Go
left, and blimb up onto another platform. Toss a Mega Grenade at the
blocked door, and go back to the water, and back to where you entered
the cave

subject: Libra warp pad
text: Bombing the barricaded door on the left platform allows you to step on the Libra warp pad to reach another part of the cave.

evidence.quote:
Jump to the platform on the left, and bomb the barricaded door. Go 
through, and step on the Libra warp pad, to be  brought to another part 
of the cave.

subject: Fancy chest
text: A fancy chest found to the left contains the Mobius Crest.

evidence.quote:
Go through the door, and navigate left. There's a fancy
chest here, containing the last Crest, the Mobius Crest.

subject: Kaeli
text: Kaeli at Otto's house gives you the Captain Cap to deliver to Captain Mac.

evidence.quote:
Again, head to Otto's house. This time, you'll be talking to Kaeli
though. She'll give you the Captain Cap, and tell you to give it to
her father, Captain Mac.

subject: Mobius pad
text: Stepping on the Mobius pad downstairs in the north-east town building warps you to the Ship Dock.

evidence.quote:
Enter the town that's in the
north-east section of town, and go downstairs. Step on the Mobius pad,
to be brought to the Ship Dock

subject: Chest
text: A chest near the Mobius pad contains Bombs and Heal Potions.

evidence.quote:
Step on the Mobius pad,
to be brought to the Ship Dock - Also, make sure to grab Bombs and 
Heal Potions from the chest.

subject: Chest
text: A chest at the southern tip of the ship contains bombs.

evidence.quote:
Head towards the middle, 
near the stearing wheel, and go down, if you want some bombs. They're
in a chest, at the southern tip of the ship.

subject: Chest
text: Pushing the barrel away reveals a chest containing Heal Potions.

evidence.quote:
Take a 
right, and kill the Thanatos, then push the barrell away, to reach a
chest with Heal Potions inside.

subject: Chest
text: Climbing across the poles between two Thanatos leads to a chest with Heal Potions.

evidence.quote:
Climb up, and over
the brown pole, pass over the grey one, and climb down another brown
one, between two Thanatos. Defeat one or both of them, grab some Heal
Potions from the chest

subject: Chest
text: Jumping over the breakable floor leads to a chest containing Refreshers.

evidence.quote:
If you go right, the floor will break, 
causing you to fall, and it's a waste of effort. If you do fall, fight
your way to the dock, and start over. If you want, you can jump over it 
though, and get the chest, which contains Refreshers.

subject: Fancy chest
text: A fancy chest in plain sight contains Gaia's Armor.

evidence.quote:
Open the fancy chest 
that's in plain sight, to get Gaia's Armor

subject: Phoebe
text: Talking to Phoebe at the Inn causes Reuben to leave and Phoebe to join the party.

evidence.quote:
Go to the Inn, and talk to
Phoebe. Reuben will leave, and Phoebe will join in place of him.

subject: Mac's Ship
text: Taking the wheel of Mac's ship on the world map sails to a new entrance to Focus Tower.

evidence.quote:
talk to Mac, who's lying down. He'll tell 
you you an take his ship. With this knowledge, go to the world map, and
head back to Mac's ship, and take the wheel! You'll reach a new entrance
to Focus Tower.

subject: Pazuzu
text: Cure every time Pazuzu uses Psyche Shield, because if you attack, he'll repel it, which is always bad.

evidence.quote:
Also, cure every  |
| Psycheshield | time he uses Psyche Shield - if you attack, he'll    |
| Sky Attack   | repel it, which is always bad.
